_doc: Gig templates for the fixer board (M6). A gig picks a template, a scene from its list, a security level weighted by reputation, and fills the title/blurb slots. Pay and rewards are HOUSE-RULE economy numbers until checked against the book's job rates. Twists (procedural complications, spec Narrative Structure) are HOUSE-RULE content; pay multiplies by the twist's pay. Unique offers (spec: 'occasional unique offers' from fixers who trust you) appear at unique_rep with that fixer. Betrayal (spec: lowered by betrayals; HOUSE-RULE): a small chance a low-rep fixer's gig is a setup (heavy twist hidden, pay withheld).

titles: {corp} wants it gone, we want it first: {data}
Get in, pull the {data}, get out
templates.blurb: {fixer} has a buyer for {corp}'s {data}. Jack in and pull the file, or put the guards down and take it the old way.

titles: The {gang} took something that isn't theirs
templates.blurb: The {gang} have dug in at the {place}. {fixer} wants the stash on their network, and nobody standing.
A {corp} insider left a door open for one night. {fixer} wants the {data} drive physically carried out before morning: grab it and get back to the extraction point.

heavy.name: Heavy security
heavy.desc: They doubled the guard. Opposition one security level up.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.desc: The grid's down in the area: no lights but the moon. Easier to sneak, harder to see.

shift_change.name: Shift change
shift_change.desc: The next shift walks in on round 6 and calls it in, quiet or not.

unique_templates.blurb: {fixer} doesn't hand this one to just anyone. A {corp} lab is moving a prototype tonight; it never arrives. Double pay, and {fixer} remembers who came through.

titles: {fixer} wants the {gang} gone. All of them.
unique_templates.blurb: The {gang} crossed {fixer} once too often. Their main crew is holed up at the {place}. This one pays like a contract, because it is one.
{fixer} has a client who'll pay anything for {corp}'s {data}, and won't say why. Deep NET, heavy ICE.
